about_the_game:
⚠Do not imitate the events in this game. For medical advice, consult a professional and always follow your doctor’s instructions.⚠

In Medicinal Cuisine Master, you play as Yin Hua, a prodigy of healing foods, venturing into a world where culinary medicine remains uncharted. Master ancient recipes, heal through flavors, and carve your legacy as the greatest herbal chef of all time!

Game Objective

During your culinary venture, accumulate both wealth and reputation while wisely managing your funds to purchase herbs and ingredients. Just remember - don't let your journey to become the Medicinal Cuisine Master end prematurely due to poor financial planning!

  • Game Mechanics

  • Customers will keep visiting your shop, each with unique ailments to cure. Prepare healing dishes by pairing medicinal herbs with complementary foods - bare herbs will be rejected!

    Every ingredient has distinct flavor traits. Liked flavors slow down the 'Fullness Meter', while disliked ones speed it up. When full, customers pay based on symptom relief (not your costs) and leave immediately.

    Survival here demands true mastery - can you thrive as a Medicinal Cuisine Master?

  • ↓ Apologies, the GIF below was not created in an English version, but the game will support English language.
